dropdown.name: a value: its option highlighted and selected
a value not among the options: the first highlighted
multi, filterOutSelected off: the first chosen highlighted

behaviour.name: a click opens, a click again closes
a click on the input opens, and again keeps it open
choose closes, and resets the input
Escape closes, pseudo-focused; Escape again clears
Tab closes and blurs, the input kept for a reset off
Tab closes and resets the input
a tap opens, a drag does not
clear: the value and the input
Backspace takes the last value back to the input
Backspace with text deletes a letter
a disabled option is not chosen
onCloseResetsInput off keeps the text on Escape
